verses.en: Unto thee, O God, do we give thanks, unto thee do we give thanks: for that thy name is near thy wondrous works declare.
verses.pt: Damos-te graças, ó Deus, damos-te graças, pois o teu nome está perto; os que invocam o teu nome anunciam as tuas maravilhas.
verses.en_web: We give thanks to you, God. We give thanks, for your Name is near. Men tell about your wondrous works.
verses.en_bbe: <To the chief music-maker; put to Al-tashheth. A Psalm. Of Asaph. A Song.> To you, O God, we give praise, to you we give praise: and those who give honour to your name make clear your works of power.

verses.en: When I shall receive the congregation I will judge uprightly.
verses.pt: Quando chegar o tempo determinado, julgarei retamente.
verses.en_web: When I choose the appointed time, I will judge blamelessly.
verses.en_bbe: When the right time has come, I will be the judge in righteousness.

verses.en: The earth and all the inhabitants thereof are dissolved: I bear up the pillars of it. Selah.
verses.pt: Dissolve-se a terra e todos os seus moradores, mas eu lhe fortaleci as colunas.
verses.en_web: The earth and all its inhabitants quake. I firmly hold its pillars. Selah.
verses.en_bbe: When the earth and all its people become feeble, I am the support of its pillars. (Selah.)

verses.en: I said unto the fools, Deal not foolishly: and to the wicked, Lift not up the horn:
verses.pt: Digo eu aos arrogantes: Não sejais arrogantes; e aos ímpios: Não levanteis a fronte;
verses.en_web: I said to the arrogant, “Don’t boast!” I said to the wicked, “Don’t lift up the horn.
verses.en_bbe: I say to the men of pride, Let your pride be gone: and to the sinners, Let not your horn be lifted up.

verses.en: Lift not up your horn on high: speak not with a stiff neck.
verses.pt: não levanteis ao alto a vossa fronte, nem faleis com arrogância.
verses.en_web: Don’t lift up your horn on high. Don’t speak with a stiff neck.”
verses.en_bbe: Let not your horn be lifted up: let no more words of pride come from your outstretched necks.

verses.en: For promotion cometh neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the south.
verses.pt: Porque nem do oriente, nem do ocidente, nem do deserto vem a exaltação.
verses.en_web: For neither from the east, nor from the west, nor yet from the south, comes exaltation.
verses.en_bbe: For honour does not come from the east, or from the west, or uplifting from the south;

verses.en: But God is the judge: he putteth down one, and setteth up another.
verses.pt: Mas Deus é o que julga; a um abate, e a outro exalta.
verses.en_web: But God is the judge. He puts down one, and lifts up another.
verses.en_bbe: But God is the judge, putting down one, and lifting up another.

verses.en: For in the hand of the LORD there is a cup, and the wine is red; it is full of mixture; and he poureth out of the same: but the dregs thereof, all the wicked of the earth shall wring them out, and drink them.
verses.pt: Porque na mão do Senhor há um cálice, cujo vinho espuma, cheio de mistura, do qual ele dá a beber; certamente todos os ímpios da terra sorverão e beberão as suas fezes.
verses.en_web: For in Yahweh’s hand there is a cup, full of foaming wine mixed with spices. He pours it out. Indeed the wicked of the earth drink and drink it to its very dregs.
verses.en_bbe: For in the hand of the Lord is a cup, and the wine is red; it is well mixed, overflowing from his hand: he will make all the sinners of the earth take of it, even to the last drop.

verses.en: But I will declare for ever; I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.
verses.pt: Mas, quanto a mim, exultarei para sempre, cantarei louvores ao Deus de Jacó.
verses.en_web: But I will declare this forever: I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.
verses.en_bbe: But I will ever be full of joy, making songs of praise to the God of Jacob.

verses.en: All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off; but the horns of the righteous shall be exalted.
verses.pt: E quebrantarei todas as forças dos ímpios, mas as forças dos justos serão exaltadas.
verses.en_web: I will cut off all the horns of the wicked, but the horns of the righteous shall be lifted up.
verses.en_bbe: By him will all the horns of the sinners be cut off; but the horns of the upright will be lifted up.
